description: Has the Japanese Consumer Affairs Agency published a national action under the Act on Specified Commercial Transactions against a company with this name? Give the name in Japanese and optionally the head office prefecture and municipality. Returns action date, types, articles, head office, suspension period, source URL, retrieved_at, page SHA-256. Status found, not_found_in_checked_records (with checked_scope) or unknown. Matched by name and location only.

municipality.description: Optional head office municipality or ward in Japanese (新宿区, 大阪市, 仙台市泉区)

name.description: Company name in Japanese, e.g. 株式会社HOPE Group (full/half width, spaces and the position of 株式会社 are normalized)

prefecture.description: Optional head office prefecture in Japanese or English (東京都, Tokyo, 大阪府, Osaka)

name: caa_action_lookup

checked_scope.description: What was checked: national actions under the Act on Specified Commercial Transactions on the CAA list, the fiscal years covered and the time of the list read.

official_check.description: Read first: actions as published by the CAA at retrieved_at, matched by name and location only; check the official action page.

provenance.description: Freshness receipts for every upstream source used.

items.description: Freshness receipt for one upstream source.

fetch_status.description: found / empty / stale / unavailable / unsupported (see catalog fetch_status_values).

retrieved_at.description: When this service retrieved the upstream data (null if unknown).

source.description: Publisher and URL of the upstream document or dataset.

upstream_updated_at.description: Update time stated by the upstream, or null when it states none.

action_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD (Asia/Tokyo): the date of the action as written on the page.

action_id.description: The 6-digit number of the CAA action page (notice/entry/NNNNNN).

head_office.description: Head office location as published next to the name; null when the page publishes none.

record_id.description: Stable id: action page number:section:respondent index.

respondent_name.description: The company named as respondent, as published (Unicode NFKC). Companies only.

same_entity_confirmed.description: Always false: matched by name and location only; no corporate number on the CAA pages.

retrieved_at.description: When this service last read the action page successfully.

status.description: listed: A record matching the query by identifier or exact name is in the version of the official record checked (status_as_of). not_found_in_checked_records: No matching record in the version checked. It says nothing about other registries, other names or periods before tracking_since. no_longer_listed_since: A matching record was seen by this service earlier and is not in the current version since the date given. The reason is not published here and is not inferred. expired: The official record itself states an end or expiry date that has passed. The reason is not inferred. unknown: Could not be determined: not checked, data unavailable or stale, or only similar-name candidates were found (see unknown_reason).

same_name_other_location.description: Records with this name whose published head office does not match the location given. They may be different companies.

action_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD (Asia/Tokyo): the date of the action as written on the page.

action_id.description: The 6-digit number of the CAA action page (notice/entry/NNNNNN).

head_office.description: Head office location as published next to the name; null when the page publishes none.

record_id.description: Stable id: action page number:section:respondent index.

respondent_name.description: The company named as respondent, as published (Unicode NFKC). Companies only.

same_entity_confirmed.description: Always false: matched by name and location only; no corporate number on the CAA pages.

retrieved_at.description: When this service last read the action page successfully.

similar_names.description: Respondents whose normalized name contains the query. Not matches.

source.description: Where the answer comes from: the CAA enforcement list and when this service last read it.

index_retrieved_at.description: When this service last read the CAA enforcement list successfully.

status.description: found = a respondent with this normalized name (and location, when given) is on the CAA list; not_found_in_checked_records = none in the action pages read (see checked_scope); unknown = list not loaded or stale, pages that may concern this name not read yet or unreadable, or location not published (unknown_reason). A status other than found is not evidence that no action exists.

terms.description: URL of the terms of service.

title: Japanese CAA commercial transactions actions (by company)
